SECTION VIII
GROWTH-INDUCING IMPACTS
This section considers any direct or indirect growth-inducint impact of the proposed action. The rehabilitation program is considered first. Because this program is directed toward the revitalization of existing neighborhoods, its effect should have a negative long-term growth-inducing effect. As a result of the demolition of some housing units and subsequent relocation of the residences, a short-term stimulus for low-cost housing could result; however, this impact is unlikely since private response to low-cost housing needs is historically sluggish.
Public works elements of the project generally have no growth-inducing effect since they are rehabilitative in nature.
